case_name: D.K. Soni v P.K. Mukerjee And Ors.
holding: The appeal must fail and is accordingly dismissed without any order as to costs.
The need indubitably succeeds and even if the allegations made are taken into consideration do not merit any revision of the order which had become final.
There was no substance in the objection filed against the execution of the order of eviction in terms of cl. (rr) of s. 43(2) of the new Act.
